sloka: ततश्चिक्षेप शेलाग्रं नीलस्त्रिशिरसे तदा।तद्रावणसुतो धीमान् बिभेद निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७०.२१ ।।
transliteration: tataścikṣepa śelāgraṁ nīlastriśirase tadā।tadrāvaṇasuto dhīmān bibheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.70.21 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Neela hit Trisira with the peak of the mountain and Ravana's son broke the mountain into pieces with arrows.
